shipping.onlyShipments: Shipping & documents settings are for organizations with the Shipments module.
shipping.title: Shipping & documents
shipping.intro: Defaults for new contracts and the texts printed on the documents made in Shipments. Existing contracts and documents keep what they were created with.
shipping.blHint: Consignee and notify party that new contracts start with.
shipping.docHint: Bank accounts, issuers and the 出庫・納入依頼書 宛先, company seal, delivery profiles and QMJP by quarter.
shipping.estHint: Courier cost + import tax estimator (shipment steps 7, 8, 12) and the invoices' due days. Port, truck size and customs rate per customer are in Org Settings → Customers.
shipping.alertsHint: When reminders fall due, the default free time at the port, when a step counts as stuck, and the daily digest e-mail.
shipping.intakeHint: Forward shipping emails to this address. Each email is kept with its attachments; nothing is filed into deals yet.
shipping.filterHint: Which senders the intake keeps. Start with the trial run, check the preview below for false drops, then enforce.

alertRules.taxFundingDaysBefore: Fund import tax — days before ETA
alertRules.anDaysBefore: Arrival Notice expected — days before ETA
alertRules.freeTimeWarnDaysBefore: Warn before free time ends — days
alertRules.stuckDays: A step is stuck after — days unchanged (0 = off)
alertRules.digestEnabled: Send the daily digest e-mail to staff (AIMS users of this org)

estimatorRates.blFee: B/L fee (輸入通関料) ¥ per B/L
estimatorRates.badNumber: Every rate must be a number ≥ 0

supplierProfiles.none: No suppliers yet — add them in Master Files.
supplierProfiles.noProfile: — no profile yet (works like Vedanta until saved)
supplierProfiles.noPI: No PI — step 1 N/A, CI paid in full
supplierProfiles.saved: {name}: profile saved — open supplier orders and shipments updated

lmeFeed.method: · monthly average = mean of the daily cash-settlement prices, rounded half-up to 2 dp · the running month is provisional until it ends.
lmeFeed.feedUnavailable: LME feed unavailable: {error}. Nothing was changed; the table keeps its values.
lmeFeed.emptyOn: No Westmetall values stored yet — use Fetch now.
lmeFeed.emptyOff: No Westmetall values stored yet (the feed is off: Preview shows what it would fill).

OFF.label: Off
OFF.hint: every email is kept and triaged

SHADOW.label: Trial run
SHADOW.hint: every email is still kept; Inbox › Filter preview shows what would be dropped

ENFORCE.label: Enforce
ENFORCE.hint: mail that fails the filter is dropped before it is stored (only a minimal log line is kept)

emailFilter.errDomain: "{domain}" is not an email domain or address (like isewan.co.jp or purchasing@gmail.com)
emailFilter.errName: The company name for {domain} must be 1–{max} characters
emailFilter.couldNotLoad: Could not load the email filter
emailFilter.needAllow: Add at least one allowed domain or address before enforcing
emailFilter.addressesHint: For people writing from a personal mailbox (gmail.com etc.) — never allow a whole public domain.
emailFilter.notes: Notes (one per line: domain or party — note)
emailFilter.alwaysKept: Always kept, whatever the list: a shipment key in the subject or an attachment name (B/L 198GX… / 22AA… / KMTC… / MEDU… / SITG… / GGVC…, contract 4540…, PI 9331…, CI XP26… / 9000…) and replies on a thread already matched to an order. Mail only between your own addresses is kept only then.
emailFilter.companiesHint: The Inbox shows the company behind each sender's domain (isewan.co.jp → Isewan). Add a domain the built-ins don't know, or rename one; an unknown domain shows the domain itself. A subdomain follows its parent (mail.sus.co.jp → SUS).
emailFilter.builtIn: Built-in — click to rename it for your organisation
emailFilter.noCompanies: No companies of your own yet — the built-ins above apply.

docSettings.errSealType: The seal must be a PNG or JPEG image
docSettings.errSealSize: The seal image must be 1 MB or smaller
docSettings.errBank: Every bank account needs a name and its text
docSettings.errProfile: Every delivery profile needs a site name
docSettings.errQmjpValue: Every QMJP quarter needs a number
docSettings.errLmeValue: Every LME month needs a price
docSettings.errDomain: "{domain}" is not an email domain (like vedanta.co.in)
docSettings.banksHint: One line per row; "label<Tab>value" prints as two columns. The selected default starts every new invoice.
docSettings.name: Name
docSettings.customerDocIssuerName: 計量検収票 / 納品書兼分析試験成績報告書 — issuer
docSettings.siIssuerName: 出庫・納入依頼書 — issuer / 出荷主
docSettings.siAddressee: 出庫・納入依頼書 — 宛先 (warehouse)
docSettings.siAddresseeHint: Blank = 三井倉庫 株式会社 御中
docSettings.sites: Delivery sites (出庫・納入依頼書)
docSettings.sitesHint: Each customer's delivery site (納入先, address, 備考 lines) is now part of its profile in
docSettings.sitesOlder: — {n} older site(s) here are still used for customers without one.
docSettings.qmjpHint: Invoice #1 takes the QMJP of its LME month's quarter; the SG→JP invoice and Invoice #2 take the shipment month's quarter. A quarter not listed falls back to the contract line.
docSettings.lmeHint: The price check compares PIs, CIs and invoices with LME of the basis month + the contract's premium (+ QMJP). A month not listed is marked "unknown", never wrong. With the Westmetall feed on, empty months fill by themselves; a month you type here is never changed by the feed.
docSettings.keep: Email intake — never purge mail from
docSettings.keepHint: Mail from, to or quoting these domains (and replies on their threads) is never deleted automatically: when the AI calls it "not shipment" it goes to Shipments › Inbox › Unsure for 14 days instead. Customers' email domains (Org Settings › Customers) are always included. Leave blank for the built-in list (Vedanta, SUS, Kato, Mitsui Soko, the carriers).

customers.onlyShipments: Customer profiles are for organizations with the Shipments module.
customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: How each trade customer is billed and served. Steps that don't apply to a customer show as "N/A (customer profile)" on its orders.
customers.none: No customers yet — add them in Master Files.
customers.suppliersIntro: Whether a supplier issues a PI (deposit on step 1) and which documents it sends with a shipment.
customers.modeSingle: SINGLE — one invoice after the B/L (shipment-month LME), due in 5 business days
customers.sendImportPermit: Send the import permit to the customer
customers.bankCheck: check — not confirmed by ADH yet; pick the account to confirm
customers.bankHint: Preselected on this customer's invoices; any entity's account
customers.addressee: 宛先 on the 計量検収票 / 納品書兼分析試験成績報告書
customers.addresseePlaceholder: Blank = the Japanese legal name (e.g. SUS株式会社 福島製造グループ)
customers.addresseeHint: Printed before 御中; the address and contact come from the customer record
customers.deliverySite: Delivery site (出庫・納入依頼書)

companyProfile.title: Company Profile
companyProfile.bankHint: Bank details will appear on invoices and other documents.
companyProfile.additionalBanksHint: Extra accounts appear below the first bank on documents, separated by "OR".
companyProfile.qrHint: Customers scan this on the Click-to-pay page from invoice emails. Save after uploading.
companyProfile.customNamesHint: Customize how document types appear to your users. For example, change "Invoice" to "BI2025" for your organization.

docDefaults.title: Doc Defaults
docDefaults.intro: Save default Terms & Conditions, Notes, and a closing Footer message per document type. New documents inherit these when the corresponding field is empty; per-document edits still win.
docDefaults.noTemplates: No document templates activated for this organization. Set one up first (Admin → Organizations → Templates).
docDefaults.tncPh: e.g. Prices are subject to confirmation. Goods sold are non-refundable…
docDefaults.footerPh: Renders at the bottom of the printed document. e.g. 'Thank you for your business.'
docDefaults.pick: Pick a document type above to start editing its defaults.
